cells.tense: What the mind holds, it holds steadily, and the holding can still choose.
cells.act: make the call and carry it through
cells.ask: Make a call you've already weighed, carry it through that same day, and keep the telling to the call itself.
cells.core:
A weighing finishes in you early, before reasons get lined up into sentences. What you take in is real, so sitting with it a while tends to produce the better answer. No case has to be built first. When words do come, they land, and people feel the weight behind them.
The place this can slip is on the far side of the pause. Holding gets comfortable, and a call keeps waiting for a moment that doesn't get announced. What got weighed was meant to become a choice, not stay as material. So take it up today and move with it. The ground stays open either way, and none of it needs explaining to a room.
cells.sheetLine: You weigh it well. Make the call and go.
cells.verb: weigh what is known before saying it
cells.place: the open ground before any one direction is chosen

cells.tense: The mind is bracing for a next moment that cannot be written in yet.
cells.act: go on toward it without needing a sign
cells.ask: Stay with the direction you already picked another stretch, with nothing confirming it, and keep the days plain.
cells.core:
The pause in you usually ends in a clear call. Lately the pause has been given a bigger job: checking ahead for proof the direction will hold. Nothing gets chosen until the future signs off first, and anything looks shaky under that light. The bracing keeps running, scanning for a signal that was not built to arrive on schedule.
Loosen that. Take the direction you already chose and stay with it a while longer, no proof attached — a week, a month, whatever a stretch is for you. What comes next is not being asked for anything. The staying is what holds, and it happens now. When a sign stops being required first, the brace loses its work.
cells.sheetLine: You're waiting for proof before you go.
cells.verb: weigh what is known before saying it
cells.place: the open ground before any one direction is chosen

cells.tense: The knowing is still standing where an older decision used to be.
cells.act: enjoy what you imagined now that it is here
cells.ask: Spend an hour with something you once wanted, which is here now, without improving it or reaching for the next.
cells.core:
That weighing used to end in a call. It carried the taking up of something concrete — a pick already made, a while back. New options show up and the needle doesn't move. The quiet is what's left over: the pause with nothing on the far end of it. Plenty got built, and it doesn't get turned around; it gets walked past.
Pushing harder won't restart anything, and neither will more feeling. Spend an hour with something you once wanted that is here now, as it stands. Don't improve it, don't line up the next one. Let the satisfaction actually land. An hour spent where what you wanted already became something restarts things from a side effort doesn't reach.
cells.sheetLine: You wanted this once. It's here now.

cells.tense: The pen is down in a room where the writing is still going on.
cells.act: accept what is offered for what you gave
cells.ask: Take what comes back for what you gave at the size it arrives — not enlarged, not waved away.
cells.core:
A weighing runs while you're moving — timing, proportion, the call itself — and if anyone asked you to describe it, the account would have none of you in it. Rooms near you end up level, and you'd call that circumstance. What you put in to get here is already spent on it. What goes quiet is the other direction: coming back. The scale that meets a return stays put.
Let one exchange run both ways. When something arrives for what you spent, take it at the size it comes. Not added to. Not refused. One even exchange, taken evenly, is enough to show you it was already doing the work.
cells.sheetLine: You keep things level. Let one run back.
cells.verb: weigh what is known before saying it
cells.place: the open ground before any one direction is chosen
